definitions.gloss: job type, type of occupation, job category
definitions.explanation: A classification or category of work, such as sales, engineering, or management. Used in job hunting, HR, and career discussions to distinguish between different kinds of work within or across companies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{職種|しょくしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
{職種|しょくしゅ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Salaries differ significantly depending on the job type.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{勤務地|きんむち}や{職種|しょくしゅ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}り{込|こ}む→絞り込む：06049_shiborikomu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: On job-switching sites, you can narrow down job listings by location and job type.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in job-hunting and HR contexts. Job postings and career sites in Japan typically categorize positions by {職種|しょくしゅ}. Not to be confused with ⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧, which refers to one's occupation or profession as a whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職種|しょくしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (choose a job type)
- {職種|しょくしゅ}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (by job type)
- {希望|きぼう}{職種|しょくしゅ} (desired job type)
- {職種|しょくしゅ}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (change of job type)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧: occupation, profession (the broader category — what you do for a living)
- ⟦{業種|ぎょうしゅ}→業種：13149_gyoushu⟧: industry, line of business (classifies the company/sector, not the role)
